Welcome.title: Welcome to the Japanese dictionary!
Welcome.subtitle: The features are as follows:
Welcome.feature2: Search from a Japanese word written in romaji, hiragana, katakana and/or kanji;
Welcome.feature3: Search from a Japanese text (the text must not be entirely written in romaji);
Welcome.feature4: For verbs and adjectives, conjugations are available;
Welcome.feature6: For each definition of Japanese words, there is a concrete example.
